description: This file contains unit tests for static activation rebalancing in an Orleans-based distributed system, verifying that activations are correctly moved between silos during rebalancing cycles.

classes.name: StaticRebalancingTests
classes.description: A test class for verifying static activation rebalancing behavior without adding new activations during the process.

methods.name: Should_Move_Activations_From_Silo1_And_Silo3_To_Silo2_And_Silo4
methods.description: An asynchronous test method that initializes activations, waits for rebalancing, and asserts that activations are moved as expected.
